descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator New Mexico puts you in the captain's seat over the real Albuquerque and the Sandia Mountains.

THE CITY
Downtown's towers, the KiMo Theatre, the Alvarado, Old Town and San Felipe de Neri, the University of New Mexico, the Rail Yards and Route 66 through Nob Hill.

THE SANDIAS
Fly under the Sandia Peak Tramway's cables, over the crest at 10,678 ft and its antenna farm, down Tijeras Canyon and past the ski area.

THE BALLOON FIESTA
Hot air balloons rise from Balloon Fiesta Park and drift down the North Valley to the river.

THE RIO GRANDE
Low down the river past its bridges, Corrales, the BioPark, the Petroglyph volcanoes and Isleta Pueblo.

A LIVING CITY
The Rail Runner and freight trains on the real tracks, traffic on I-25 and I-40. At night Central Avenue glows with neon.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances and your landing clearance.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on the West Mesa. Repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT AND ELEVEN MISSIONS
Two private jets, a midsize jet and a fighter. Sunport and Double Eagle approaches, the Rio Grande Run, the Balloon Fiesta, a Kirtland scramble, a city tour and the city by night.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.

English and Spanish menus.
